8189.title: Transient availability errors become cached negative capability
8189.rootCauseOneLine: Failed parent availability reads overwrite known capabilities with an unavailable fallback cached for the full 30-second success TTL.

prReviews.verdict: Static review only: targets the verified root cause; branch not executed.

8189.proposedFix: Distinguish read failure from authoritative capability results, retain bounded last-known-good availability, and retry transient errors sooner. Existing PR 8187 covers the same root cause for duplicate issue 8188; no duplicate fix was opened.
8189.caveats: Real local HTTP and the production two-second timeout were used; cache time was injected to exercise the default 30-second TTL. Live provider login and retry UI were not exercised. Reproduction source is embedded in the report in accordance with the reports repository policy.
